description: The operator decision queue, derived from real loop objects (approvable verdicts, blocked proposals, breaker events, expiring evidence). READ-ONLY: queue ACTIONS (approve/snooze/acknowledge) remain dashboard-session-only and are not exposed to API-key callers. Requires the optimization_model_v3 flag (404 while off). Response is envelope-shaped: every numeric leaf is a MeasuredValue {value, ci_low, ci_high, method, data_through}. ci fields are null unless the source payload carries a real confidence interval — never fabricated. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.
name: metrx_get_decision_queue
title: Get Decision Queue
